questions.question: Which hosted e-commerce platform uses Liquid themes and has its own app store?
questions.explanation: Shopify storefront themes are built with the Liquid templating language, and the Shopify App Store extends stores.

questions.question: Which WordPress plugin creates online stores?
questions.explanation: WooCommerce turns WordPress into an e-commerce site.

questions.question: What open-source platform offers enterprise features?
questions.explanation: Magento provides robust enterprise e-commerce solutions.

questions.question: What Shopify feature automates order fulfillment?
questions.explanation: Shopify Fulfillment handles shipping and delivery.

questions.question: Which platform uses themes for design?
questions.explanation: All major platforms support customizable themes.

questions.question: Which BigCommerce tool manages product listings across marketplaces like Amazon and eBay?
questions.explanation: BigCommerce Channel Manager syncs listings with marketplaces and social channels.

questions.question: Which platform requires self-hosting?
questions.explanation: WooCommerce needs separate web hosting.

questions.question: What extends platform functionality?
questions.explanation: Plugins add features to e-commerce platforms.

questions.question: Which Shopify plan supports unlimited products?
questions.explanation: All Shopify plans allow unlimited products.

questions.question: What tracks customer purchases?
questions.explanation: Analytics monitor sales and customer behavior.

questions.question: Which e-commerce platform is owned by Adobe?
questions.explanation: Adobe acquired Magento, now branded Adobe Commerce.

questions.question: What is Shopify's templating language?
questions.explanation: Liquid templates render Shopify storefront themes.

questions.question: WooCommerce is built on top of which CMS?
questions.explanation: WooCommerce is a plugin that extends WordPress.

questions.question: What does SaaS stand for in hosted e-commerce?
questions.explanation: SaaS platforms deliver software via subscription hosting.

questions.question: Which platform's Buy Button embeds products on external sites?
questions.explanation: Shopify Buy Button embeds checkout anywhere on the web.

questions.question: Where do merchants find extensions for their Shopify store?
questions.explanation: The Shopify App Store lists third-party add-on apps.

questions.question: Which open-source PHP platform targets small to mid-size merchants?
questions.explanation: PrestaShop is free open-source PHP e-commerce software.

questions.question: What pricing model do hosted platforms typically use?
questions.explanation: Hosted platforms charge recurring subscription fees.

questions.question: What feature lets customers buy without creating an account?
questions.explanation: Guest checkout skips mandatory account registration.

questions.question: Which database does WooCommerce use through WordPress?
questions.explanation: WordPress and WooCommerce store data in MySQL.

questions.question: Which Shopify plan is built for large enterprises?
questions.explanation: Shopify Plus serves high-volume enterprise merchants.

questions.question: What feature emails shoppers who left items unpurchased?
questions.explanation: Abandoned cart recovery re-engages lost shoppers by email.

questions.question: Which platform was formerly known as Demandware?
questions.explanation: Salesforce acquired Demandware, renaming it Commerce Cloud.

questions.question: What does PCI DSS compliance protect?
questions.explanation: PCI DSS standards secure cardholder payment data.

questions.question: Which platform natively integrates with Square point-of-sale?
questions.explanation: Square Online syncs directly with Square POS systems.

questions.question: What is selling through a store plus marketplaces like Amazon called?
questions.explanation: Multichannel selling lists products across sales channels.

questions.question: A startup wants zero server maintenance: monthly subscriptions, automatic updates, and hosted checkout. Which platform type fits?
questions.explanation: SaaS platforms like Shopify bundle hosting and maintenance into the subscription fee.

questions.question: WooCommerce is developed by which company, the same one behind WordPress.com?
questions.explanation: Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com, acquired WooCommerce in 2015.

questions.question: A platform must certify it safely stores, processes, and transmits cardholder data. Which standard governs this?
questions.explanation: PCI DSS is the payment card industry's mandatory security standard for cardholder data.

questions.question: A company deploys Adobe Commerce (Magento) on its own cloud servers to keep full code control. Which deployment model is this?
questions.explanation: Self-hosting gives full code and infrastructure control at the cost of managing the stack.

questions.question: Orders on a store's site are packed and shipped by the supplier under the store's name; the store never holds inventory. Which model?
questions.explanation: Dropshipping forwards orders to suppliers who fulfill directly to the customer.
